title: 5th Workshop on “Parameterization of Lakes in Numerical Weather Prediction and Climate Modelling” (LAKE 2017)
description: Held in Berlin, Germany, focusing on recent developments in lake parameterization schemes for atmospheric models.

title: 4th Workshop on “Parameterization of Lakes in Numerical Weather Prediction and Climate Modelling” (LAKE 2015)
description: Presentations and workshop summary covering lake-atmosphere interactions and lake modeling.

title: Global Lake Database Version 2 (GLDBv2) Released
description: Dataset comprising ca. 14,000 freshwater lakes and 220 saline lakes with indirect mean depth estimates based on geological origin (Choulga et al. 2014).

title: Tellus A Special Issue on Lake Parameterization (LAKE 2012)
description: Volume 66 of Tellus A thematic cluster with papers from the 3rd Workshop at the Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI).

title: FLake Operational in ICON and ECMWF IFS
description: FLake went operational in DWD ICON on 20 January 2015, and in ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) on 12 May 2015.

title: FLake Operational at German Weather Service (DWD)
description: Operational within COSMO-EU since 15 December 2010, and within COSMO-DE convection-permitting ensemble (2.8 km mesh) since 18 April 2012.

title: FLake-Global Online Tool Published in Env. Modell. Soft.
description: Kirillin et al. (2011), FLake-Global: Online lake model with worldwide coverage, Environmental Modelling & Software.
